findings.title: Create the queued timestamp for each assignment
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` created without an explicit `queued` value receives the same timestamp. In a long-lived worker, assignments received hours later therefore carry the module-import time in their serialized context rather than their actual creation time. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` to generate the timestamp for each instance.
